# Vendored zsh plugins

These source-only plugins are committed so a new shell never needs network
access during startup or first apply.

| Plugin | Version | Upstream |
| --- | --- | --- |
| zsh-autosuggestions | 0.7.1 | https://github.com/zsh-users/zsh-autosuggestions |
| zsh-syntax-highlighting | 0.8.0 | https://github.com/zsh-users/zsh-syntax-highlighting |

The upstream license is stored beside each plugin. Update the script, license,
and this table together.
